verdict.rationale: The OpenAI API documents its own credential controls. Project API keys can be given expiration dates, admins can enforce a maximum key lifetime, and admins can restrict creation to service-account keys, which suit a dedicated agent identity scoped to a project. The pack does not show fine-grained permission scoping, so true least-privilege is unproven. missing for 10: documented per-key permission scopes (e.g. read-only or endpoint/model restrictions), explicit agent-oriented credential guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: You can now set expiration dates when creating project API keys.
Administrators can allow only service-account keys, allow only user-owned project keys, or disable all new API key creation.
Administrators can also enforce a maximum key lifetime at the organization or project level in Platform settings, requiring newly created keys to expire within the configured limit.
